content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CUO Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUO Research Staffs recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Central University of Odisha Research Staffs recruitment is 25th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Staffs at CUO?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for Research Staffs posts at the Central University of Odisha, including Research Associate, Research Assistant, and Field Investigator positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: For the Research Associate position, candidates need a Post Graduate degree in any Social Science discipline with at least 55% marks, along with NET/M.Phil./Ph.D. and two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for a Field Investigator at CUO?
faq.answer: The salary for a Field Investigator at the Central University of Odisha is Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their detailed CV and required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for CUO Research Staffs recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the Central University of Odisha Research Staffs recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Staffs positions at CUO involves the scrutiny of CVs followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these Research Staffs positions at the Central University of Odisha is temporary.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" link.
